display.purpose: H1, brand/eyebrow lines, buttons — self-hosted variable font, weights 300-800.

label.purpose: Uppercase 12px labels, e.g. the Hero's brand line beneath the H1.

shadows.name: card-contact

shadows.name: cta-lift
shadows.purpose: Ambient warm glow under an isolated orange CTA (MagneticCta).

motion.name: ease-standard

components.name: Primary Button (Accent Pill)
components.description: The one call-to-action fill on either surface. Used for 'Empecemos' in the nav and the Hero's primary CTA.
components.html: Empecemos
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 52px; padding: 0 32px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #F47B20; color: #1A0F3D; font-family: 'Sora', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 200ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #FF9440; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F47B20; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary-icon { transition: transform 200ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover .ds-btn-primary-icon { transform: translateX(2px); }

components.name: Ghost Button (Light Surface)
components.description: Secondary CTA on the light Hero, always purple-bordered, never a second orange treatment.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 52px; padding: 0 28px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(75,42,147,0.25); color: #1A0F3D; font-family: 'Sora', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; background: transparent; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 200ms, background-color 200ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: rgba(75,42,147,0.5); background: rgba(75,42,147,0.05); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F47B20; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Capability Card
components.description: Warm-white card that cross-fades to a purple-to-orange diagonal gradient on hover via a ::before layer; never moves, scales, or tilts.
components.html:
Planificación Estratégica

Definimos objetivos, enfoque y ruta de acción.
components.css: .ds-cap-card { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 24px; border-radius: 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(75,42,147,0.1); background-color: #FDFBF7; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(26,15,61,0.06); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-cap-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; border-radius: inherit; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #4B2A93 0%, #6D4BC9 55%, #F47B20 100%); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-cap-card:hover::before, .ds-cap-card:focus-within::before { opacity: 1; } .ds-cap-card-icon { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(75,42,147,0.2); background: rgba(75,42,147,0.08); color: #4B2A93; transition: color 300ms, background-color 300ms, border-color 300ms; } .ds-cap-card:hover .ds-cap-card-icon { color: #fff; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3); } .ds-cap-card-title { margin-top: 16px; font-family: 'Sora', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; color: #1A0F3D; transition: color 300ms; } .ds-cap-card:hover .ds-cap-card-title { color: #fff; } .ds-cap-card-desc { margin-top: 8px; max-width: 34ch; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; color: #57516B; transition: color 300ms; } .ds-cap-card:hover .ds-cap-card-desc { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); }

components.name: Floating Nav
components.description: Glass-panel floating navbar on the warm-white surface, with a shared-layout active pill over the current route's link.
components.html: DOFIFENIAXEL SOCIO
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; padding: 8px; border-radius: 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(75,42,147,0.1); background: rgba(253,251,247,0.8); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; } .ds-nav-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'Sora', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; color: #57516B; text-decoration: none; transition: color 200ms, background-color 200ms; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #1A0F3D; background: rgba(75,42,147,0.06); } .ds-nav-link-active { color: #4B2A93; background: rgba(75,42,147,0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(75,42,147,0.15); }

narrative.northStar: Un Mar de Ideas, en dos mareas.
narrative.overview: DOFI's shipped system is deliberately two surfaces, not one. The historical base — Services, Process, Manifesto, Tools, Socio, Contact, Footer, LogoWall, Clients — is a single locked dark atmosphere (Tema bloqueado: DARK, per its own globals.css header): deep purple abyss, one orange accent, no exceptions. Layered on top of that base, the front-of-house triplet (Navbar, Hero, Banda de capacidades) was rebuilt onto a warm-white canvas, so the visitor's first impression is light while the rest of the site stays in its original dark register. This split is a shipped, intentional migration boundary confirmed by the codebase's own comments, not an inconsistency to smooth over. Both surfaces share the same two brand hues — DOFI purple and DOFI orange — so the accent vocabulary never forks: only the roles of background and text invert between them. Motion across both surfaces is restrained and functional: entrance-only transforms (never opacity, to protect LCP on the H1), CSS-driven infinite float on hero text/CTA, and hover treatments that change color or opacity — never scale, tilt, or rotate a card. A prior cursor-tracking spotlight technique on the capability cards was removed outright and replaced with a plain chromatic hover; that removal is now a hard rule, not a lingering technique to revive.
keyCharacteristics: Two coexisting surfaces (dark base, light front-of-house) sharing one accent vocabulary, never blended into a hybrid gray-brand palette.
Orange (#F47B20) is the only actionable accent on either surface; purple is structural/textual, never itself a call-to-action fill.
Pill-shaped interactive elements, 20px-radius cards, 12px-radius fields — one radius per role, not one radius for everything.
Hover changes surface color/opacity only; transform is reserved for scroll-entrance and ambient float.
Content-editable regions (Hero copy/image, capability cards) degrade to hardcoded fallbacks identical to what shipped before Sanity.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Orange (--color-accent) is the only fill color a button or CTA ever takes, on either surface. Purple never fills an actionable element — it is structure, text, or a soft passive tint (nav-active pill, hover gradient), never a call-to-action background.

rules.name: The Surface-Locked Ink Rule
rules.body: --color-deep (#1A0F3D) is the single hex value that plays two roles: a dark surface on the site's base theme and the ink (text) color on the light front-of-house. This is intentional reuse, not two different tokens that happen to collide.

rules.name: The Transform-Not-Opacity Rule
rules.body: The Hero's H1 and CTA never animate via opacity on entrance — only transform: translateY(...), because the H1 is the LCP element and cannot render invisible.

rules.name: The No-Hard-Shadow Rule
rules.body: No component on either surface uses a hard-offset, unblurred shadow. Depth is conveyed through tonal layering (dark) or soft, low-opacity blur (light).

dos: Do treat orange (#F47B20/#FF9440) as the only fill color for any actionable button or CTA, on either surface.
Do keep the pill / 20px-card / 12px-field radius roles distinct — don't collapse them into one generic rounded-lg.
Do use tonal layering or soft (≤0 1px 2px, low-opacity) shadows for depth; never a hard, unblurred offset shadow.
Do animate card hover as a color/opacity cross-fade on a ::before layer, never as a transform.
Do keep light-surface borders as low-opacity brand tints (border-brand/10–/25), not neutral gray.
Do ship every CMS-driven region (Hero, capability cards) with a hardcoded fallback identical to the last-approved copy.
donts: Don't blend the two surfaces into a single 'medium' palette. Dark sections stay on the locked dark tokens; only Navbar, Hero, and the capability band use the light tokens.
Don't reintroduce cursor-tracking spotlight/glow (--mouse-x/--mouse-y, radial mask following the pointer) on cards. It was built, then removed by explicit brief instruction.
Don't use purple as a button fill. It is structural and textual only.
Don't let a capability or Hero card gain transform on hover (scale, tilt, rotate, translate). Motion on hover is reserved for icon color and text color/opacity only.
